_description: Schema for the multi-GPU attention workload evaluation report at /app/report.json

_value.ridge_point: float: peak_flops_per_sec / bandwidth_bytes_per_sec, where bandwidth uses SI convention (1 GB = 1e9 bytes)

_value.attention_flops: int: total FLOPs for one attention layer across all heads (each fused multiply-add = 2 FLOPs; both QK^T and score-value matmuls contribute)
_value.attention_memory_bytes: int: total HBM bytes accessed per layer (read Q using h query heads, read K using h_kv KV heads, read V using h_kv KV heads, write O using h query heads)
_value.kv_cache_bytes: int: total KV cache bytes across all layers (includes both key and value tensors, uses h_kv heads per layer)

_value.is_memory_bound: bool: true if arithmetic_intensity < ridge_point for this GPU

_value.optimal_gpu: string: GPU name with highest roofline_tflops among those where kv_cache_fits is true; ties broken by peak_tflops descending, then GPU name ascending alphabetically

critical_prefill_seq_lens._value: int: smallest integer L such that the arithmetic intensity for prefill (seq_len_q = seq_len_kv = L, batch_size=1) meets or exceeds this GPU's ridge point, using the attention config from analysis.json critical_prefill section

group_size_analysis._key: group size g as string (only include valid divisors: n_heads % g == 0)
group_size_analysis._value: float: decode-phase arithmetic intensity with h_kv = n_heads/g, using params from analysis.json group_size_sweep section
